## What happened

Describe the observed result and what you expected.

## Reproduce

Include the smallest workflow and exact commands needed to reproduce the problem.

## Environment

- Titan version
- Operating system
- Bun and Node versions
- Codex or Claude Code version
- Installation method

## Evidence

Include relevant error output or a screenshot. Remove credentials, personal data and private project content before posting.
